Description.English: Shared sub-mod. Adds Galena Ore (Celtic/Albion raw good) and two Albion galena mines (Merchant and Smith variants, mountain slot), each occasionally yielding a little Gold Ore as a byproduct. Everything ships locked: the mod that uses it decides how the mines and the ore are unlocked. Extracted from Lead, Lamps and Silverware by Kydiaz. Do not modify; include as is.
